function.arguments: {"reflection":"The initial search returned four highly relevant benchmark sources. The official Rewards for Justice page supplies a current United States government description, aliases, Russian-government-linked assessment, operating dates and victim statistics, but it is a reward notice and does not establish criminal liability. The Justice Department victim page supplies named defendants, case numbers, charges, procedural dates, and explicit presumption-of-innocence language. Rapid7 and Center for Internet Security summarize leaked chats and internal organization, but the excerpts are incomplete and secondary; I must label their claims as reporting/assessment rather than proven facts and avoid inventing details not present. Missing are primary Treasury sanctions, indictments/court filings, and more detailed leak evidence on leadership, affiliates, payment/negotiation procedures, and identities. Search narrowly for those gaps, while preserving exact source IDs returned."}
function.name: think_tool
